description: Existing NCR closure endpoint. Its request body, authorization (originator or designate only), preconditions (status must be 'Final Approval'; traveler sign-off for traveler-initiated NCRs) and error responses are unchanged. This feature adds one field to the success response, and a best-effort step that runs after the closure has been saved (spec FR-022, FR-027, FR-029).

closure_pdf.message: string — present only when status is 'failed'; a short human-readable reason (never a stack trace or a file path)
closure_pdf.pdf_id: string — present only when status is 'attached'

example_attached.message: NCR closed successfully. Final distribution sent to all stakeholders.

closure_pdf.message: The traveler this NCR was linked to no longer exists.

example_failed.message: NCR closed successfully. Final distribution sent to all stakeholders.

semantics.not_applicable: The NCR is not traveler-linked. No attachment is produced and no event is written (spec FR-026).
semantics.attached: The PDF was written, its TravelerNcrPdf record inserted, and a 'traveler.pdf_attached' event appended to the NCR.
semantics.failed: Closure is NOT undone or blocked (spec FR-027). A 'traveler.pdf_failed' event with the reason is appended to the NCR, the failure is logged, and any partially written file is removed. Reasons include: traveler removed, input no longer in the traveler's form, render error, disk or database error.
semantics.duplicate: If a TravelerNcrPdf already exists for (traveler, ncr_id) the step reports 'attached' without creating a second one (unique index).

client_behaviour.views/ncr-close.jade: Read data.closure_pdf in the AJAX success handler. When status is 'failed', show a warning alert (separate from #close-error) with the message and the text that the NCR itself was closed. When 'attached' or 'not_applicable', no extra UI.

notes: Sequence inside closeNcr: existing steps -> await ncr.save() -> attachClosurePdf (guarded, cannot throw) -> refreshTravelerProgress (guarded) -> return.
The PDF is built from the NCR as saved, so it includes the 'ncr.closed' and final-distribution events but not its own attach event.
The PDF step runs regardless of the traveler's status at that moment (spec FR-029).
